A1.justification: Both PDFs describe ConfTuner and contain readable main text, equations, six figures, nineteen tables, and Appendices A-F. The added checklist and blank pages in v2 do not create substantive comparison gaps.

before.justification: Section 4 and Appendices E-F report original calibration, accuracy, runtime, ablation, self-correction, and model-cascade experiments.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experimental results in Section 4 and Appendices E-F.

M1.justification: The confidence-token distribution, tokenized Brier objective, fine-tuning procedure, and LLaMA regularization remain unchanged in Section 3 and Appendices D-E.

E1.justification: Both versions use HotpotQA, GSM8K, TriviaQA, StrategyQA, and TruthfulQA. Numerical, linguistic, and implicit confidence evaluation, GPT-4o calibration, self-correction, and model-cascade scenarios are retained.

E2.justification: Base, Ensemble, LACIE, and SaySelf retain their participation in the corresponding comparisons. Appendix F also preserves the P(True), external-classifier, and GPT-4o comparisons without changing comparator membership.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 and Appendix D retain the same base models, evaluation samples, ECE and AUROC metrics, decoding procedures, training settings, and correctness assessment. The downstream evaluation protocols are also unchanged.

E4.justification: Appendices E-F retain the regularization, training-size, confidence-format, training-distribution-shift, answer/confidence-order, and classifier-initialization analyses. Their relocation does not add or remove analyses.

E5.justification: Ensemble standard deviations already appear in v1 Appendix F.6, Table 18, and are unchanged in v2. The added checklist refers to existing uncertainty reporting without introducing run counts, seeds, intervals, or statistical tests.

E6.justification: Tables 1-19 and the empirical figures retain the same results. For example, LLaMA ConfTuner's average ECE remains 0.1082 and AUROC remains 0.6740 in Tables 1-2; relocated appendix tables contain no new or revised result entries.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, tokenized Brier formulation, Definition 1, Theorem 1, and Appendix B proof are unchanged. Some equations move across page boundaries without mathematical revision.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about principled verbalized calibration, efficiency, generalization, black-box calibration, and downstream benefits. The added overview phrase about implicit confidence refers to an existing experiment.

C2.justification: Result interpretations and mechanism explanations are retained, as are Section 6's limitations concerning complex conversational contexts and practical calibration. The checklist adds no substantive scientific qualification.

D1.justification: Appendices C-D preserve the prompts, hardware, software, LoRA settings, hyperparameters, answer-judging procedures, and access links. The checklist largely points to existing disclosures and supplies no new actionable reproduction details.

R1.justification: The same 38 references and the research positioning in Section 5 and Appendix A are retained. Added conference-policy links in the checklist do not change the relationship to prior research.

P1.justification: v2 adds acknowledgments and a NeurIPS checklist, updates the publication footer, removes the corresponding-author note, and makes a small overview and punctuation edit. Scientific prose and section organization remain essentially unchanged.

P2.justification: v2 inserts two blank pages and the checklist, reflows text, and relocates several appendix displays, including Table 9/Figure 6 and Tables 16-19. Figure content, table structures, captions, and numbering are retained.

improvement.justification: v2 preserves the method, proof, empirical evidence, limitations, and reproducibility information. Acknowledgments and checklist declarations add administrative information but resolve no substantive scientific deficiency. The blank pages and display relocations have limited presentation effects, leaving overall paper quality essentially unchanged.
